title: Building with MCP and Claude Code: Sentry's 0 to 1 Story
description:
Discover how leading organizations are transforming their workflows with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Claude Code. Join David Cramer, CPO and Co-founder, at Sentry, alongside Jeremy Hadfield and Ilana Nathans from Anthropic as they share real-world implementation stories and practical strategies for success.

In this webinar, David will walk through Sentry's journey adopting MCP and Claude Code, from initial exploration to production deployment. Learn how his team integrated Claude into their development workflows, the challenges they overcame, and the measurable impact on productivity and code quality. You'll hear firsthand insights on building with agentic AI tools and see live demonstrations of the solutions they've built.

Whether you're just getting started with Claude Code or looking to scale your MCP implementation, this session offers actionable takeaways from a technical leader who's been in the trenches.
